name: beta_lactoglobulin_bovine
rationale: Globular, two disulfides plus one free cysteine, no essential PTM. The best-characterised precision-fermentation whey target.

name: alpha_lactalbumin_bovine
rationale: Globular, four disulfides, calcium-binding; no PTM required for function.

name: alpha_lactalbumin_human
rationale: Human variant, titers reported in K. phaffii.

name: alpha_s1_casein_bovine
rationale: Intrinsically disordered phosphoprotein; the phosphoserines nucleate colloidal calcium phosphate, so phosphorylation is functionally required, not incidental.

name: alpha_s2_casein_bovine
rationale: As alpha-S1, most heavily phosphorylated of the caseins.

name: beta_casein_bovine
rationale: Disordered, five phosphoserines, amphiphilic; the dominant casein by mass in bovine milk.

name: kappa_casein_bovine
rationale: Micelle-stabilising; carries O-glycans on the C-terminal macropeptide as well as phosphoserines. The only casein with disulfides.

name: lactoferrin_bovine
rationale: Large, 16 disulfides, iron-binding, heavily N-glycosylated.

name: lactoferrin_human
rationale: Human variant; titers reported in K. phaffii and Y. lipolytica.

name: osteopontin_bovine
rationale: Extensively phosphorylated and disordered; a useful extreme for the PTM axis.

name: ovalbumin_chicken
rationale: The egg-white reference target; one disulfide, one sequon, no essential PTM.

name: ovotransferrin_chicken
rationale: Large, 15 disulfides, iron-binding.

name: ovomucoid_chicken
rationale: Nine disulfides and six sequons in 186 residues: the densest secretory load in the panel.

name: lysozyme_c_chicken
rationale: Small, four disulfides, a classical high-titer secretory benchmark.

name: avidin_chicken
rationale: Small, one disulfide, tetrameric.

name: leghemoglobin_lbc2_soybean
rationale: Soy leghemoglobin LBC2. Accession settled in data/external/LEGHEMOGLOBIN_IDENTITY.md: the Shao 2022 3.5 g/L anchor names LBC2, which is gene LB4 / P02236, NOT the LGB2 gene (P02235, whose protein name is leghemoglobin C1). Produced intracellularly, so no glycosylation, no vesicular transport and no ER disulfide formation.

name: myoglobin_pig
rationale: Porcine myoglobin; titers reported in K. phaffii. Cytosolic.

name: serum_albumin_human
rationale: 17 disulfides. Included as a secretory-capacity ceiling, not as a food target; must be excluded from food-only analyses.

name: chymosin_bovine
rationale: Long-established fungal and yeast secretion benchmark.

name: cbhi_cel7a_trichoderma
rationale: The native T. reesei workhorse; defines that host's secretory ceiling.
